Process.title: A Thoughtful Creative Process

steps.title: Discovery & Brief
steps.description: We begin by exploring your business, goals, audience and requirements together, establishing a clear creative direction before any design begins.

steps.title: Research & Design

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Everything you need to know before starting your project.

items.question: What design services do you offer?
items.answer: I provide logo design, brand identity, product packaging and labels, social media design, business cards, flyers, roll-ups, billboards, vehicle wraps and other marketing materials for businesses of all sizes.

items.question: How does the design process work?
items.answer: Every project starts with a discussion about your business and goals. I then create concepts, collect feedback and refine the design before final delivery.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: Timelines vary depending on the project scope. Most logo and branding projects are delivered within a few days, while larger projects may require additional time.

items.question: How much does a project cost?
items.answer: Pricing depends on the project scope and requirements. After discussing your needs, I provide a clear quote upfront with no hidden fees.

items.question: Do I receive the source files?
items.answer: Yes. Final deliverables can include editable source files such as AI, EPS, PSD and other formats depending on the project.

items.question: Who owns the rights to the final design?
items.answer: You do. Once the project is completed and approved, you receive full ownership and commercial rights to the final design.

items.question: Can I request revisions?
items.answer: Yes. Revisions are included to ensure the final design aligns with your expectations and business goals.

items.question: Do you work with international clients?
items.answer: Yes. I work with clients worldwide and have successfully completed thousands of projects across multiple industries.

items.question: What information do you need to get started?
items.answer: A brief description of your business, your goals, design preferences and any references you would like to share.

items.question: How can we start working together?
items.answer: Simply fill out the contact form and tell me about your project. I will get back to you as soon as possible.

FinalCTA.title: Ready to Elevate Your Brand?
FinalCTA.description: Whether you need a logo, a complete brand identity, social media content or marketing materials, I'd love to hear about your project.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How MFLABZ collects, uses, and protects personal information submitted through this website.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
paragraphs: This website is operated by MFLABZ, a freelance graphic design studio run by Manuel Fontenelle, based in Paris, France.
If you have questions about this policy or your personal data, contact us at mflabz3@gmail.com.

sections.title: 2. Information we collect
paragraphs: We collect personal information only when you choose to contact us through the website contact form. This may include:
list: The service you are interested in
Project details and any other information you include in your message

sections.title: 3. How we use your information
paragraphs: We use the information you submit to respond to your inquiry, discuss your project, and provide design services if we work together.
We do not sell your personal information and we do not use it for unrelated marketing without your consent.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis for processing
paragraphs: If you are located in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, we process your personal data on the basis of your request to be contacted and our legitimate interest in responding to business inquiries.
If we enter into a client relationship with you, we may also process your data as necessary to perform a contract or prepare for one.

sections.title: 5. How long we keep your information
paragraphs: We retain contact form submissions for as long as needed to respond to your inquiry and manage any resulting business relationship.
If no project moves forward, we generally delete or anonymize inquiry data within a reasonable period, unless we are required to keep it for legal, accounting, or dispute-resolution purposes.

sections.title: 6. Service providers
paragraphs: We use trusted third-party providers to operate the website and deliver contact form messages by email. These providers process data only on our instructions and for the purposes described in this policy.
Our website is hosted on Vercel and contact inquiries may be delivered through Resend.

sections.title: 7. Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: This website does not currently use advertising cookies or third-party analytics trackers.
Essential technical data may still be processed by our hosting provider to deliver the site securely and reliably.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict, or object to certain processing of your personal data, and to request data portability.
If you are in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, you also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.
To exercise your rights, email mflabz3@gmail.com.

sections.title: 9. International transfers
paragraphs: Some of our service providers may process data outside your country of residence, including in the United States.
Where required, we rely on appropriate safeguards for international data transfers.

sections.title: 10. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The latest version will always be published on this page with an updated date.
